dedupe_keys.name: ggcp10 global gridded crop production dataset at 10 km 2010 2020

description: Annual maps of crop production for maize, wheat, rice and soybean at 10 km resolution. The Scientific Data paper (published 18 December 2024) says GGCP10 covers 2010 to 2020, estimated with data-driven models trained by agroecological zone that combine statistics, gridded production, agroclimatic and agronomic indicators, satellite land products and ground data, then calibrated to regional statistics and evaluated against gridded, survey and statistical data. The dataset is free on Harvard Dataverse (doi 10.7910/DVN/G1HBNK) and the code is archived on Zenodo; the paper is under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is global croplands for the four crops. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): CC0-1.0. For simulation it gives where staple crops are produced each year, to estimate production lost to floods, droughts or heat and knock-on food supply shocks. A related catalogue record is the CROPGRIDS global crop areas dataset. The underlying files were not downloaded, so their contents are not verified here.
